name: Content Slideshow
summary: A swipeable sequence of 1-5 narrated content cards that teach concepts before an activity tests them. Like a Scenario (#15) without the questions — pure storytelling.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates both narration and image prompts. Core Grej-style format. The Spark generator writes each slide's narration specifically to set up the activity that follows — this is not generic prose, it's pedagogically sequenced storytelling.

slides.description: Array of narrated slides. Each slide teaches ONE concept in 1-3 sentences of conversational storytelling. The kid swipes or taps to advance.

title.description: Short card title (2-6 words). Displayed as heading above narration.

narration.description: 1-3 sentences of conversational, wonder-driven storytelling. NOT encyclopedic prose — this should feel like a friend telling you something cool. Max ~80 words per slide.

imagePrompt.description: Vivid image description for AI image generation. Following Grej of the Day rules: images only, no text overlaid on image. Should be specific, atmospheric, and evocative.

factIds.description: IDs of facts from the fact sheet that this slide teaches. The activity that follows this slideshow MUST share at least one of these factIds in its _factRefs.

ux.mobileNotes: Full-width cards with narration below image area. Swipe left/right or tap arrow to advance. Dot indicator at bottom shows slide position. Last slide's 'Next' button fires onComplete. On small screens, image occupies top 40%, narration bottom 60%.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Max 2-3 slides per slideshow. Short narration (1-2 sentences, ~40 words per slide). Large text (18px body). Vivid, playful image prompts. 'Got it!' button instead of arrow.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 2-4 slides. Standard narration (2-3 sentences, ~60 words). 16px body. Mix of atmospheric and explanatory images.
ageAdaptations.14-16: 2-5 slides. Denser narration allowed (2-3 sentences, ~80 words). 16px body. More sophisticated imagery. May include brief quotes or data points in narration.
